channel.title: 7News · Agents
channel.description: Agents channel: original summaries from official sources

item.title: Tencent Cloud MCP Square open-content reprints need authorization
item.description: Tencent Cloud developer community copyright notice for MCP Square: posts are author-authorized; no reprint without permission—policy note, not a feature launch.

item.title: Kimi Agent Swarm: up to ~100 parallel sub-agents, top-tier research preview
item.description: Agent Swarm replaces long-horizon single-agent serial work with self-organized division of labor; with K2.5, up to ~100 sub-agents and 1,500+ tool calls, ~4.5× faster than serial—top-tier research preview.

item.title: NVIDIA: build Rust tool-calling parsers for new models with AI agents
item.description: frontend-crates: reusable Rust tool-call parsers shared with Dynamo; agents generate parsers + tests; handle truncation, malformed calls, and markup leaks.

item.title: LangSmith Tool Gateway public preview: unified tool identity and policy
item.description: LangSmith Tool Gateway preview: one kit URL for MCP/built-in tool credentials, identity, deny/approval, and tracing—alongside LLM Gateway; works with Claude Code / Cursor MCP clients.

item.title: Skyflow interceptor on AgentCore Gateway de-identifies tool calls
item.description: Skyflow Detect as an AgentCore Gateway request/response interceptor: vault tokenization for tool args, model context, and document links; three Shield modes; fail-closed by default; no agent/tool code changes.

item.title: AgentCore Payments adds Marketplace x402 billed in USD on the AWS invoice
item.description: AgentCore Payments adds AWS Billing so agents can discover and buy Marketplace x402 products, charged per use in USD on the developer’s AWS bill—session budgets and Gateway connector; no stablecoin wallet.

item.title: AgentCore Harness upgrade: Strands defaults and lifecycle hooks
item.description: AgentCore Harness defaults to open-source Strands; built-in tools and context management; lifecycle hooks can allow/deny tool calls; existing harnesses pick up the upgrade automatically.

item.title: Foundry Toolboxes expand skills, Web IQ search, and A2A orchestration
item.description: Foundry Blog: Toolboxes share tools/skills/agents via one MCP endpoint; Ignite adds Skills, Web IQ search, Fabric/Work IQ, A2A GA, Snowflake/MongoDB/Databricks, plus browser automation and Computer Use GA.

item.title: Foundry Browser Automation: enterprise cloud browsers via MCP tools
item.description: At Ignite 2026 Microsoft Foundry expands Browser Automation with richer MCP browser tools, Live View, and human take-control for portals and legacy apps without APIs.

item.title: Parallel web search fast mode free on Vercel AI Gateway through Jan 31
item.description: Vercel Changelog: Parallel fast web search free on AI Gateway through 31 Jan 2027 with ZDR default; eve’s web_search uses Parallel fast when models run via Gateway.

item.title: Meta’s AI agents push ads-ranking techniques across a model fleet
item.description: Meta Engineering explains using AI agents to propagate proven ads-ranking techniques across heterogeneous models—cutting the engineering and compute cost of a combinatorial technique×model search space.

item.title: LangSmith Coding Agents beta tracks spend by merged PRs
item.description: LangChain: LangSmith Cloud public beta links GitHub/GitLab PR/MR outcomes to thread spend for coding agents—Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Deep Agents.

item.title: Foundry Hosted Agents: subnet IP sharing lifts planned concurrency
item.description: At Ignite 2026, Foundry Agent Service adds production fixes for hosted agents, including subnet IP sharing—planning estimates jump a /24 from ~250 to ~60,000 sessions, with regional quotas still the practical ceiling.

item.title: Microsoft Foundry Dev Pack goes GA for one-install agent tooling
item.description: Foundry Blog: Dev Pack GA installs Foundry CLI (azd ai), Foundry Skill, VS Code Toolkit, and Copilot app plugin in one shot—winget, brew, or Linux script.

item.title: Airbnb runs coding agents on Bedrock with cost-per-task evals
item.description: AWS case study: Airbnb’s AirChat hits Bedrock via an LLM gateway; pre-rollout evals set defaults and reasoning ceilings by score and cost per task, then CloudWatch checks production drift.

item.title: Microsoft Decision-1.1 lands on Vercel AI Gateway
item.description: Vercel Changelog: microsoft/decision-1.1—more accurate, better calibrated, and faster than Decision-1; Boolean/Choice/Score structured answers; same request shape; AI SDK ≥7.0.128.

item.title: Microsoft IQ ships as enterprise context for every agent
item.description: Azure Blog: Microsoft IQ unifies Work, Fabric, Foundry, and Web IQ plus 350+ connectors; business plugins reuse context across Copilot, Foundry MCP, and ChatGPT/Claude; Web IQ broadly available from ~$1 per 1k calls.

item.title: LangChain on proactive agents — memory and review UX
item.description: LangChain: proactive agents wake on events and schedules toward goals; over 70% of internal GTM Agent and Robin runs come from schedules; memory (seed/feedback/outcomes) plus high-signal review UX are the scarce resources.

item.title: LangSmith Enterprise adds layered controls for sensitive traces
item.description: LangChain: LangSmith Enterprise can hide trace inputs/outputs, grant access by user group, and apply ABAC from root-run metadata—store full fidelity, show least privilege.

item.title: GitHub’s Agent Host Protocol for cross-device sessions
item.description: GitHub Engineering describes an Agent Host Protocol aimed at continuing agent sessions across devices instead of tying them to one local host.

item.title: Continuous improvement lands in Microsoft Foundry at Ignite
item.description: Azure Blog: Foundry’s Establish→Identify→Optimize→Validate loop for agents— Insights GA, annotated traces, Agent Optimizer, skill/cost optimization preview, and Managed/Programmed Training.

item.title: LangChain: shifting agents from tasks to goals
item.description: LangChain argues agent UX is moving from user-specified tasks to user-specified goals, with agents decomposing, executing, and revising task lists iteratively.

item.title: LangChain rebuilt LangSmith around the agent record
item.description: LangChain blog: after Series C, LangSmith Agent Platform centers one agent object—owner, immutable ID, type—with environments and traces under it; governance for any OTLP runtime.

item.title: LangChain on Goal Engineering: scope agents for better feedback
item.description: Harrison Chase et al.: design long-horizon agent goals so humans can give high-quality feedback easily; Actively AI moved from per-account agents to cross-account motions on Deep Agents.

item.title: Parallel Decisions Fast is free on Vercel AI Gateway through Nov 23
item.description: Vercel Changelog: parallel/parallel-decisions-fast searches the live web for typed questions with probabilities and citations—free through 2026-11-23, no Parallel account needed.

item.title: LangChain raises $300M Series C at a $3B valuation
item.description: LangChain announced a $300M Series C at a $3B valuation, centering LangSmith as the platform to run, improve, and govern agents—citing 7,000+ organizations.

item.title: GitHub: build agent skills once, run them on any client
item.description: GitHub Blog’s practical guide to Agent Skills: versioned SKILL.md folders, Proof Agent verification, and Data Forge pipelines—tools and credentials stay with the host.

item.title: Workflow SDK 5: encryption, every-region runs, agent-grade speed
item.description: Vercel’s Workflow SDK 5 encrypts event-log payloads with AES-256-GCM, keeps runs in the starting Function region, and cuts queue hops—latency gains about 1.6×–25× vs v4 in their benches.

item.title: MCP moves to two spec releases a year—last Tuesdays in March and September
item.description: MCP maintainers lock a six-month release cadence and a Release Manager role. Next target is 2027-03-30; unfinished proposals slip instead of delaying the train.

item.title: Gemini Decision 1 lands on Vercel AI Gateway
item.description: Vercel Changelog: multimodal google/gemini-decision-1 returns Boolean probabilities, choices, and scores for routing and policy checks—no generation tokens.

item.title: SenseTime at Japan’s NexTech Week with embodied AI demos
item.description: SenseTime and partners exhibited at NexTech Week TOKYO 2026 Autumn, showing SenseMart Go, Xiaotu, Kaiwu 3.1, ACE Ego Kit, and TX01 dual-arm robots.

item.title: AWS shows Spring AI agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
item.description: AWS ML Blog walks Java teams through spring-ai-agentcore: familiar Spring patterns on Bedrock, with a travel assistant and multi-agent IDP examples.

item.title: MCP drafts a file uploads and downloads extension
item.description: The MCP blog outlines an experimental File Uploads extension so large files can move out-of-band between clients, servers, and storage—aimed to stabilize by year-end.

item.title: How Workday built an enterprise agent platform on LangGraph and LangSmith
item.description: LangChain case study: Workday’s Agent Platform uses LangGraph for orchestration and LangSmith for tracing and evals, wrapping internal gateways under strict enterprise compliance.

item.title: How LangChain’s GTM Agent ships consistent sales artifacts
item.description: LangChain details GTM Agent artifact generation: 1,540 docs in 12 weeks; deals with a sent artifact advanced ~47% vs ~16% matched controls.

item.title: Workflow SDK writes over WebSockets on Vercel by default
item.description: Vercel Changelog: Workflow SDK 5.2.0+ sends event and stream writes to Vercel Workflows over a WebSocket instead of one HTTP request per write; new runs pick it up after upgrade.

item.title: LangChain: Eval-Driven Development for improving AI agents
item.description: LangChain outlines Eval-Driven Development: define success, write evals before changes, compare results, and keep evals running through release and production.

item.title: Vercel AI Gateway adds DeepSeek Search and Fetch tools
item.description: Vercel Changelog: DeepSeek Search and Fetch are available via AI Gateway with one API key for any tool-calling model—no separate DeepSeek account required.

item.title: AWS practice: a serverless MCP gateway to the data lake on ECS Fargate
item.description: An AWS team describes a metadata-driven MCP server on ECS Fargate so agents reach an enterprise data lake through one gateway—new datasets need only a JSON metadata file.

item.title: Chat SDK agents can stream generative UI with json-render
item.description: Vercel Changelog: Chat SDK agents write a typed JSON catalog that json-render turns into platform-native cards such as Slack Block Kit and Teams Adaptive Cards.
